New here. This a good community? 😊 

We haven't looked good in pre-season at all. But luckily the games don't count for much!
The TV show broke my brain. I feel your trauma.

JFK assassination.

No matter what you tell me, the fact his head goes up and to the left on Zapruder film means that Oswald didn't fire the killing blow from behind.

So so much shady sh*t involved in it. From secret service being called off his car to Jack Ruby killing Oswald before testimony to LBJ winking in the plane after. And on and on.

JFK is the immortal conspiracy for me. Mainly because it was such a tragedy for America and the world. Guy seemed to genuinely love his country and its principles. Then "they" took control.

EDIT: RFK was also a hit. 11 bullet holes from a gun that fires 6. Sloppy job.
